title: Writing a method
summary: Every part of a method declaration, using clamp.

steps.title: The declaration
steps.say: This lesson has no scaffolding: you write the whole first line yourself.

marks.label: always these two words, for now

marks.text: double value, double min, double max
marks.label: parameters: type and name each

steps.title: The body
steps.say: `return` hands the answer back and ends the method right there.

steps.title: Calling it
steps.say: The caller passes values in the same order as the parameters.

steps.title: Open Main.java
steps.say: Press **Ctrl+P**, type `Main` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find it
steps.say: It may be further down. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `write a method named clamp` and press Enter to jump to it.

waitFor.hint: find write a method named clamp with Ctrl+F.

steps.title: Your turn
steps.say: Write `clamp` right under this comment. The names and types must match exactly.
